newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Wheat, soy flat, nearby corn down.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Wheat, soy flat, nearby corn down.

text.p: FOB wheat and soybean basis values were steady on Wednesday while nearby corn offers were slightly lower amid a dearth of export activity, brokers said.
Wheat futures prices at the CBOT, KCBT and MGE exchanges closed sharply higher, sparking a drop in U.S. Gulf CIF values, but brokers noted FOB prices held steady.
"The Dec/March spread is narrowing and the CIF basis is softening a bit but nothing is happening to FOB yet," the broker said.
Nearby wheat futures prices climbed by 15-1/2 to 16-1/2 cents per bushel on Wednesday at the three exchanges.
Floor traders attributed the jump to tight world stocks and technical trade, noted little export news.
Brokers welcomed news that U.S. agricultural officials would go to Turkey to discuss a recent trade dispute but showed little optimism that grain trade with Turkey would resume any time soon.
